response.justification: Candidate is an experienced, versatile software engineer but lacks the core requirements for this role: no substantial C++ experience (only a brief 6-month stint with C/C++ components in 2014-2015), no Windows platform development background, no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure despite some fintech-adjacent work (RIDE Capital) that used JavaScript/TypeScript rather than C++.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering track record across many domains and technologies
Some exposure to financial-services adjacent company (RIDE Capital investment platform)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and clear resume writing
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months in 2014-2015), far short of the 5-10 years required
No evidence of Windows platform development; career is largely Linux/web-focused
No SQL Server or Oracle experience, and no fixed income/derivatives domain knowledge

key_factors.factor: Lack of required C++ depth and recency
No fixed income/capital markets domain experience
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform experience
